name: LDAP latency over time
description: LDAP authentication and simple query round-trip time by site direction.
kql:
LatencyReports_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| extend Series = strcat(SourceSite, " -> ", TargetSite)
| summarize Value = avg(Latency_ms) by Timestamp = bin(TimeGenerated, _BinSize), Series
| order by Timestamp asc
